name: The Day We Saved the Zoo
original_name: The Day We Saved the Zoo
overview: On a scorching New Year’s Day, the keepers of Mogo Wildlife Park face the unthinkable. As a catastrophic fire bears down - the evacuation order is clear: leave now or risk your lives. But for these keepers, the animals aren’t just exhibits. They’re family, friends, confidants - and in some ways, their kin. With no help coming, they must make an impossible choice: flee to safety or stay behind to protect the creatures they love. How far would you go to save an animal?
